en: A vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of the Iglesia del Pilar, a church in Santiago de Compostela, Spain. The image shows the church's façade with baroque architectural elements, including a bell tower, a coat of arms above the main entrance, and a cross at the apex. There are trees partially framing the church, and a few people are visible near the entrance. The right side of the postcard contains a block of Spanish text describing the church and other notable churches in Santiago de Compostela.
